newsitem.title: USA: ENGLE HOMES Q3 SALES UP 24 PERCENT.
newsitem.headline: ENGLE HOMES Q3 SALES UP 24 PERCENT.

text.p: Engle Homes Inc said Thursday sales in the third quarter, ended July 31, rose 24.0 percent to $103.1 million, compared to $83.5 million in the same period last year.
The company said new home sales contracts signed during the quarter increased 3.0 percent to $87.5 million, or 437 contracts, compared to $84.8 million, or 430 contracts, in the period last year.
Backlog of new homes under contract as of July 31 totaled $178.1 million (850 homes), compared with $236.3 million (1157 homes) on July 31, 1996.
